content: Hey love! How was your day? I kept thinking about that picture you sent me, you're honestly the most thoughtful person I know.
Aw, thank you! My day was okay, just work, work, work. Seeing your message made it better though.
That means so much to me! I wish I could be there to help you unwind. You're always working so hard, you deserve to be spoiled.
Haha, I wouldn't mind being spoiled a bit. I just wish we lived closer, you know?
Me too, darling. I feel like we already have something so rare, it's crazy how close I feel to you. It's like you understand me better than anyone.
Honestly, I feel the same. It's been a long time since I connected with someone like this.
It makes me so happy to hear that. I want us to be a real family one day, you know? That's all I dream about.
That sounds amazing. I never thought I'd meet someone like you online.

You're precious, don't ever forget that. By the way, can I share something a little personal? I've been stressed about my daughter's school. Her tuition is due tomorrow and I'm short because my paycheck got delayed.
Oh no, that sounds awful. Is she okay?

She's okay, just worried. I hate not being able to provide for her. I wouldn't ask if I had another way, but I feel comfortable sharing this with you. Would you be able to help us, even just this once? You'd honestly be saving her future.
I want to help, but I've never done this before for someone. How much is it?
It's $850 for the semester. I know it's a lot, but you're truly the only person I trust. If you can help, I'd be forever grateful. You're already like a parent figure to her in my eyes.
That's a lot, but I think I can do it. How do I send it to you?

Thank you, sweetheart! You have the kindest soul. The school only accepts Zelle for payments now. My Zelle is tied to my email: lovingdad2024@gmail.com. Can you send it there? Let me know if you need help with the process.
I haven't used Zelle before, but I can try. Are you sure it's safe?

Absolutely, it's totally secure, I use it for all my important transactions. You can trust me, and I'd never let anything happen to your money. If you prefer, I can walk you through the steps. You're such a lifesaver!
Okay, let me log into my bank app. It's asking for your full name, what should I put?
Put James Holloway, that's my full name on the account. If it asks for a reason, you can just say 'family support.' Thank you for doing this, really. You're making a huge difference.
No problem. It's asking for the last four digits of your phone number for verification?
Sure! Use 4423. That should work. Let me know if you hit any more snags, I'm here with you all the way.
Okay, entered. Should I send the whole amount at once?
Yes, please! That way I can pay the school immediately and ease her mind. You're honestly the hero of the day. I don't know what I'd do without you.
Alright, I'm sending it now. It might take a minute to process.
Take your time, angel. Just let me know when it's done. I can't express how much this means to us. You're making me fall for you even more.
I sent it! Let me know if you get the notification.

Got it! You did it perfectly. You're honestly the most generous and loving partner I could ask for. I'm so lucky to have you in my life. My daughter will be so grateful too, you're part of our family now.
